name: - SheepFarm
fix_description: In register, add villages[user].timestamp = block.timestamp after registration. Currently the timestamp is never set, so the require(villages[user].timestamp == 0) check always passes, allowing the same user to register multiple times and claim GEM_BONUS repeatedly.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is a very short, direct exploit with only a few simple contract calls and no flash loans, price manipulation, or complex cross-protocol interactions. It appears to abuse straightforward protocol logic/accounting around repeated registration and village upgrades, which a competent auditor could likely identify and weaponize quickly.
